title: What changed in prediction markets
insights:
- **Kalshi set another volume record:** It traded 3.96B contracts on Oct. 11, topping its Oct. 10 record of 3.91B and running about 67% above its 30-day daily average of 2.37B; parlays made up 2.75B contracts, about 69% of the day, versus a recent daily average of 1.47B.
- **Polymarket US had a major volume jump:** Its 580.9M contracts on Oct. 10 were 63% above its 30-day daily average of 355.7M, for an approximate 11% market share.
- **OG/Crypto.com more than doubled its recent pace:** It traded 170.5M contracts on Oct. 11, 175% above its 30-day daily average of 62.0M, for an approximate 3.2% market share.

evidence.label: Additional context 1
evidence.sql:
WITH venue_days AS (
    SELECT date, platform, contracts
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform <> 'Kalshi'
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE)
      AND date <= DATE '2026-10-11'
),
latest AS (
    SELECT platform, MAX(date) AS report_date
    FROM venue_days
    GROUP BY platform
)
SELECT l.platform,
       l.report_date,
       v.contracts AS latest_contracts,
       AVG(p.contracts) AS prior_30_day_daily_average,
       (v.contracts / NULLIF(AVG(p.contracts), 0) - 1) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_average
FROM latest l
JOIN venue_days v
  ON v.platform = l.platform AND v.date = l.report_date
JOIN venue_days p
  ON p.platform = l.platform
 AND p.date >= l.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
 AND p.date < l.report_date
GROUP BY l.platform, l.report_date, v.contracts
ORDER BY pct_change_vs_average DESC;

evidence.label: Additional context 2
evidence.sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS report_date
    FROM daily_overall
    WHERE is_partial IS NOT TRUE
      AND date <= DATE '2026-10-11'
),
window_data AS (
    SELECT d.date, d.contracts_total, t.notional_total
    FROM daily_overall d
    JOIN taker_notional_daily t USING (date)
    CROSS JOIN latest l
    WHERE d.is_partial IS NOT TRUE
      AND d.date <= l.report_date
      AND d.date >= l.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
)
SELECT MAX(date) AS report_date,
       MAX(contracts_total) FILTER (WHERE date = (SELECT report_date FROM latest)) AS contracts,
       MAX(notional_total) FILTER (WHERE date = (SELECT report_date FROM latest)) AS taker_side_notional,
       AVG(contracts_total) FILTER (WHERE date < (SELECT report_date FROM latest)) AS prior_30_day_average_contracts,
       AVG(notional_total) FILTER (WHERE date < (SELECT report_date FROM latest)) AS prior_30_day_average_taker_notional,
       MAX(notional_total) FILTER (WHERE date = (SELECT report_date FROM latest))
         / NULLIF(AVG(notional_total) FILTER (WHERE date < (SELECT report_date FROM latest)), 0) AS taker_notional_multiple_of_average
FROM window_data;

evidence.label: Additional context 3
evidence.sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS report_date
    FROM sports_market_type_daily
    WHERE date <= DATE '2026-10-11'
),
daily_types AS (
    SELECT date,
           CASE WHEN market_type LIKE 'Parlay%' THEN 'Parlay' ELSE market_type END AS market_type,
           SUM(contracts) AS contracts
    FROM sports_market_type_daily
    WHERE date <= DATE '2026-10-11'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
types AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT market_type FROM daily_types
),
calendar AS (
    SELECT CAST(generate_series AS DATE) AS date
    FROM latest,
         generate_series(
             latest.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY,
             latest.report_date,
             INTERVAL 1 DAY
         )
),
grid AS (
    SELECT c.date, t.market_type
    FROM calendar c
    CROSS JOIN types t
),
filled AS (
    SELECT g.date, g.market_type, COALESCE(d.contracts, 0) AS contracts
    FROM grid g
    LEFT JOIN daily_types d USING (date, market_type)
)
SELECT f.market_type,
       MAX(f.contracts) FILTER (WHERE f.date = l.report_date) AS latest_day_contracts,
       AVG(f.contracts) FILTER (
           WHERE f.date >= l.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
             AND f.date < l.report_date
       ) AS prior_30_day_daily_average,
       (MAX(f.contracts) FILTER (WHERE f.date = l.report_date)
         / NULLIF(AVG(f.contracts) FILTER (
             WHERE f.date >= l.report_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
               AND f.date < l.report_date
         ), 0) - 1) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_average
FROM filled f
CROSS JOIN latest l
GROUP BY f.market_type, l.report_date
ORDER BY latest_day_contracts DESC;

anchor.question: Build the anchor table for today's Predict Charts industry briefing. For each prediction-market venue, use its latest complete reported day and return venue, report date, reported contract volume, the average of its prior seven complete reported days, and percent change versus that average. Use daily_overall for Kalshi and exclude rows where is_partial is true. Use competitor_daily only for platforms other than Kalshi, add ProphetX from prophetx_daily, and add CME from cme_daily. Never use competitor_daily's Kalshi row; it is not the authoritative Kalshi total. In competitor_daily the `complete` column is only populated for Polymarket_US and is NULL for every other platform, where NULL means the row IS complete. Filter it as COALESCE(complete, TRUE) or omit the filter entirely; never write `complete = TRUE`, which silently discards every platform whose flag is NULL. Exclude partial days. CME is the sparse bulletin series; a normal seven-day lookback spanning seven calendar days is regular, not sparse. Resolve the latest complete reported day SEPARATELY FOR EACH VENUE. Do not filter the whole result to one shared calendar date, and do not require a venue to have a row on the newest date any venue reported: a venue whose most recent complete day is a few days old is reporting normally and still belongs in the table, on its own date. Each venue's prior-seven-day baseline is its own prior seven REPORTED days, which for an irregular reporter spans more than seven calendar days. Every one of these ten venues must appear in the result: Kalshi, Polymarket US, ForecastEx, DKeX, Underdog Exchange, OG/Crypto.com, ProphetX, Novig, Rothera, CME. OG/Crypto.com is the platform stored as 'Crypto.com/Nadex'.
anchor.sql:
WITH venue_days AS (
    SELECT
        'Kalshi' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts_total AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM daily_overall
    WHERE is_partial IS NOT TRUE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CASE platform
            WHEN 'Polymarket_US' THEN 'Polymarket US'
            WHEN 'Crypto.com/Nadex' THEN 'OG/Crypto.com'
            ELSE platform
        END AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform IN (
        'Polymarket_US', 'ForecastEx', 'DKeX', 'Underdog Exchange',
        'Crypto.com/Nadex', 'Novig', 'Rothera'
    )
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'ProphetX' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM prophetx_daily
    WHERE COALESCE(complete, TRUE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'CME' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        cme_total_vol AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM cme_daily
),
ranked_days AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        report_date,
        reported_contract_volume,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY venue
            ORDER BY report_date DESC
        ) AS day_rank,
        AVG(reported_contract_volume) OVER (
            PARTITION BY venue
            ORDER BY report_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prior_seven_reported_day_average
    FROM venue_days
)
SELECT
    venue,
    report_date,
    reported_contract_volume,
    prior_seven_reported_day_average,
    (reported_contract_volume / NULLIF(prior_seven_reported_day_average, 0) - 1) * 100
        AS percent_change_vs_prior_seven_day_average
FROM ranked_days
WHERE day_rank = 1
ORDER BY venue;
